# Chengguang Automotive Battery Database

JIS, DIN, BCI automotive battery specifications, cross-reference, and vehicle fitment.

## Sitemap
- Battery Models: https://data.chengguangenergy.com/battery-models/
- JIS Standard: https://data.chengguangenergy.com/standards/jis/
- DIN Standard: https://data.chengguangenergy.com/standards/din/
- Cross Reference: https://data.chengguangenergy.com/cross-reference/
- Terminals: https://data.chengguangenergy.com/terminals/
- Vehicle Fitment: https://data.chengguangenergy.com/vehicle-fitment/
- BCI Standard: https://data.chengguangenergy.com/standards/bci/
